europe_now.title: EU Budget Deadlock
europe_now.summary: European Union leaders failed to reach an agreement on the upcoming budget during a recent tense summit. The discussions also highlighted deep divisions regarding proposed spending measures and significant financial support packages.

sources.headline: EU: Leaders fail to reach agreement on next budget after tense summit
EU leaders split over budget spending and a $49 billion loan to Ukraine

europe_now.title: Spanish General Election
europe_now.summary: Spain's general election is approaching with key campaigns centering heavily on the housing crisis and immigration debates. Political leaders made final pushes ahead of the vote as polls indicate a closely contested political landscape.

sources.headline: Spain election: Housing crisis and immigration dominate final campaign debate
Spain’s Pedro makes final campaign push to beat the right ahead of crunch vote

top_stories.title: European Central Bank Leadership
top_stories.summary: Hernández de Cos has been tapped to lead the European Central Bank as it prepares for forthcoming economic challenges. Observers describe the appointment as a pragmatic liberal choice for steering monetary policy.

sources.headline: Hernández de Cos, the pragmatic liberal tapped to head the ECB and take on Europe’s upcoming challenges

top_stories.title: Polish Constitutional Controversy
top_stories.summary: The disputed Polish constitutional court announced a twelve-month suspension of its chief justice. Meanwhile, international expert findings regarding the Smolensk air disaster were officially released.
